svg.title: Contract Readout Non-invertibility and retained data Where M02 Finite frame fibre and section π(r, A)e = r−1 x Aery; reverse links are inverses. Readout forgets frame representatives; it does not quotient physical gauge equivalence. Physical gauge acts by r 7→rg−1, A fixed. Thm. 7.1 M03 Paths and physical gauge action Interior frames cancel; open paths transform at endpoints and loop traces read unchanged. A trace alone discards conjugacy and other matrix information; full link history remains retained. §7 M04 Normalized Wilson measure and insertions π∗eμ = μW ; insertion F reads F ◦π. No unnormalized gauge volume; normalization and integrability remain part of the contract. Thm. 7.2 M05 Tangent operators and quadratic forms p2TZ = Tp1 and TZj1 = j2T; compositions insert piji = I. Vertical frame directions remain null. Operator transport differs from adjoint form pullback. No ambient vertical coercivity follows. Thm. A.1 M06 Actual nonlinear predictors and horizontal derivatives Coarse π(s, B) = P(π(r, A)); differentiated frame terms cancel in the coarse readout. Multivalued branches remain tagged relations; no invented selection or bound on arbitrary unbounded frame rates. §A M07 Tested limits and quantitative estimates Exact scalar identity IZ λ = Iλ at every tag. No exchange of limits, stronger test class, derivative of hard masks, new compactness or mixing of unrelated partition functions. Thm. B.1 M08 Operations, relations and residual histories πσ = id at every composable intermediate stage. No discard of branch tags or auxiliary histories merely because functions coincide. §B M09 Reflection quotient, fields and spectrum Unitary U : [v] 7→[pv] between completed reflection spaces. Null histories are quotiented; an unbounded field is not promoted to a bounded whole-space operator. Rank-one vacuum is not a positive spectral gap. Thm. C.1 M10 Compression algebra and phase measure Whole-word character evaluation; ρZ = h∗ρ. Factors cannot be read separately without a proved product identity. Almost-everywhere statements require the original continuity/ full-support upgrade. Thm. D.1
